private_equity_performance.why_not_twr: Quarterly, lagged NAVs and irregular capital flows make a time-weighted return misleading for private market assets. Industry practice is to report TVPI, DPI, RVPI and since-inception net IRR.

aggregate.irr_note: Since-inception net IRR requires the full LP cash flow series from fund inception, which is not held in this system. Source from the GP capital account statement.

by_fund.irr_note: Net IRR not computable: full LP cash flow history from fund inception is not held in this system. Manager-reported IRR should be sourced from the quarterly capital account statement.
Net IRR not computable from data held. TVPI below 1.0x reflects the standard J-curve: management fees and early-stage write-downs depress NAV before value creation is realised.

private_equity_performance.guardrail: PE figures must be presented as at the NAV date, never as a current value. TVPI below 1.0x in early vintages reflects the J-curve and must not be characterised as a loss.

asset_class_treatment.bridge_treatment: PE NAV movement appears as its own `pe_nav_movement` line in every attribution bridge so that each bridge still foots to ending market value, while remaining outside the TWR numerator.
asset_class_treatment.agent_guidance: When answering a portfolio performance question, quote `twr_pct` and state that it excludes private equity. If the query specifically concerns PE, read `performance.private_equity_performance` instead and always cite the NAV date.
